title: Sports and Arts
intro: Sports, physical education, painting, music, dance and theatre.

nodes.label: Music, dance or theatre classes
nodes.note: Join classes and take grade exams. Many universities offer a BA in Music, Dance or Theatre by marks or audition.

nodes.label: BPEd or Sports Science
nodes.note: 2 to 4 years. Train to coach and teach.

nodes.label: BFA or BVA (fine arts)
nodes.note: 3 to 4 years of painting, sculpture and applied art.

nodes.label: BA in Music, Dance or Theatre
nodes.note: 3 years of performance and teaching.

nodes.label: Athlete
nodes.note: Compete for your school, state and country.

nodes.label: Coach or PE teacher
nodes.note: Train players and teach sport in schools.

nodes.label: Sports scientist or physiotherapist
nodes.note: Help athletes get fit and recover.

nodes.label: Artist or illustrator
nodes.note: Paint, draw and design.

nodes.label: Musician, dancer or actor
nodes.note: Perform on stage, screen or online.

nodes.label: Art teacher or curator
nodes.note: Teach art or run exhibitions.

nodes.label: Referee or umpire
nodes.note: Run matches fairly.

nodes.label: Sports manager
nodes.note: Manage teams and events.

nodes.label: Fitness trainer
nodes.note: Train people to be strong and fit.

nodes.label: Sports journalist
nodes.note: Report on sports.

nodes.label: PE teacher
nodes.note: Teach sport in schools.

nodes.label: Painter
nodes.note: Create art for galleries and homes.

nodes.label: Sculptor
nodes.note: Make art from stone, metal or clay.

nodes.label: Art therapist
nodes.note: Use art to help people heal.

nodes.label: Gallery manager
nodes.note: Run art shows and sales.

nodes.label: Singer
nodes.note: Perform songs live or in studios.

nodes.label: Dancer or choreographer
nodes.note: Perform and create dances.

nodes.label: Actor
nodes.note: Act in plays, films and shows.

nodes.label: Music teacher
nodes.note: Teach an instrument or singing.

nodes.label: Sound engineer
nodes.note: Record and mix music and sound.
